p1: [low, uneasy] Every morning, Ryan found a new photo on his phone. Of himself, asleep.
[whispers] Taken at three twelve a.m. Ryan lives alone.
[low] His phone charges in the kitchen. And Ryan has never sleepwalked in his life.
[low, tense] Each night, the photos got closer. Last night... just his face.
[low] So Ryan left his phone on the bench, filming the hallway.
[whispers, tense] At exactly three twelve, his bedroom door opened. Ryan walked out.
[whispers] Eyes shut. Barefoot. He picked up the phone and carried it back to bed.
[low] Then he opened the photo from that night.
[whispers, frightened] Ryan. In bed. Fast asleep.
[low, unsettled] But Ryan has never sleepwalked in his life. So who was in the hallway?
[whispers, tense] He played the video again. Right before it cut out...
[whispers, terrified] The man opened his eyes. Looked into the camera. And smiled... with Ryan's face.
[whispers, slow, menacing] Go back to sleep, Ryan.
[low, somber] Ryan sleeps in his car now.
[low, ominous] This morning, a new photo. Ryan, asleep at the wheel.
